Reform Elsewhere has no single universal trigger. It can be used in response, for example, to a declared attack, sudden danger, a collapse, an explosion, hostile movement or another event that genuinely leaves room for a Reaction. The Game Master determines case by case whether the event is sufficiently immediate and perceptible to allow its use.
